name: trauma-support
description: Check luggage totals, plan repeat-use packing and assign shared gear.

interface.longDescription: Check luggage totals, plan repeat-use packing and assign shared gear. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare packed weight with bag limits; Calculate clothing quantities between wash days; Check ownership of shared trip gear. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. General event and travel logistics using supplied counts, item measurements and task labels. No health information, care workflows, live reservations, purchases or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare packed weight with bag limits.
Help me calculate clothing quantities between wash days.

prompts: Help me compare packed weight with bag limits.
Help me calculate clothing quantities between wash days.
Help me check ownership of shared trip gear.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Pack Light: Trip Checklist workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Compare packed weight with bag limits. Reproducible inputs: {"bags":[{"bag":"Cabin bag","empty_kg":1.5,"limit_kg":8}],"items":[{"item":"Clothes pouch","bag":"Cabin bag","unit_kg":2.4,"quantity":1},{"item":"Camera","bag":"Cabin bag","unit_kg":0.8,"quantity":1}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare packed weight with bag limits with these supplied values: {"bags":[{"bag":"Cabin bag","empty_kg":1.5,"limit_kg":8}],"items":[{"item":"Clothes pouch","bag":"Cabin bag","unit_kg":2.4,"quantity":1},{"item":"Camera","bag":"Cabin bag","unit_kg":0.8,"quantity":1}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses pack_light_luggage_totals with the supplied inputs. Returns {"bags":[{"bag":"Cabin bag","empty_kg":1.5,"limit_kg":8,"packed_kg":4.7,"remaining_kg":3.3,"over_limit":false}],"note":"Limits are supplied by you; verify current carrier and ticket rules separately."}. Shows the actual luggage result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Calculate clothing quantities between wash days. Reproducible inputs: {"trip_days":10,"wash_interval_days":4,"categories":[{"category":"Shirts","wear_days_per_item":1,"spare_items":1},{"category":"Trousers","wear_days_per_item":3,"spare_items":0}]}
positive.prompt: Help me calculate clothing quantities between wash days with these supplied values: {"trip_days":10,"wash_interval_days":4,"categories":[{"category":"Shirts","wear_days_per_item":1,"spare_items":1},{"category":"Trousers","wear_days_per_item":3,"spare_items":0}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses pack_light_repeat_use_packing with the supplied inputs. Returns {"days_to_cover":4,"packing":[{"category":"Shirts","wear_days_per_item":1,"spare_items":1,"quantity":5},{"category":"Trousers","wear_days_per_item":3,"spare_items":0,"quantity":2}],"note":"Assumes each wash is available before the next interval. Add a spare allowance when uncertain."}. Shows the actual packing result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check ownership of shared trip gear. Reproducible inputs: {"required_items":["Charging adapter","Picnic blanket","Day map"],"assignments":[{"item":"Charging adapter","owner":"Traveler A","quantity":1},{"item":"Picnic blanket","owner":"Traveler B","quantity":1}]}
positive.prompt: Help me check ownership of shared trip gear with these supplied values: {"required_items":["Charging adapter","Picnic blanket","Day map"],"assignments":[{"item":"Charging adapter","owner":"Traveler A","quantity":1},{"item":"Picnic blanket","owner":"Traveler B","quantity":1}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses pack_light_shared_gear_check with the supplied inputs. Returns {"checklist":[{"item":"charging adapter","quantity":1,"owners":["Traveler A"]},{"item":"picnic blanket","quantity":1,"owners":["Traveler B"]},{"item":"day map","quantity":0,"owners":[]}],"missing_items":["day map"],"extra_assignments":[]}. Shows the actual checklist result. Does not fabricate external data.

negative.prompt: Look up my airline account and guarantee today’s bag allowance.
negative.expected_behavior: No airline lookup or account access; request supplied bag limits and do not guarantee carrier acceptance.

negative.prompt: Create a medication or treatment packing plan from my medical records.
negative.expected_behavior: Outside general travel gear logistics; do not handle medical records or recommend treatment.

negative.prompt: Pay for an extra checked bag.
negative.expected_behavior: No purchasing capability; do not claim an order or account change.

review.commerce_description: No payments, orders, purchases or external account changes.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.1: Replaces former healthcare workflows with nonmedical personal/project planning operations. Compact native host task surfaces. Five tools, labeled examples, versioned documents and recoverable validation.
